symptom: PC1 cannot communicate with VLAN 10 devices
evidence_output: Fa0/1 is assigned to VLAN 20 but PC1 should be in VLAN 10
fix: interface fa0/1;switchport access vlan 10
verification: PC1 communicates with VLAN 10 devices

symptom: Devices cannot access VLAN 10
evidence_output: VLAN 10 is not listed on the switch
fix: vlan 10;name USERS
verification: VLAN 10 appears in show vlan brief

symptom: VLAN 10 traffic is not passing between switches
evidence_output: VLAN 10 is not in the allowed VLAN list
fix: interface g0/1;switchport trunk allowed vlan add 10
verification: VLAN 10 traffic passes across the trunk

symptom: PC has no network connectivity
evidence_output: Fa0/1 is administratively down
fix: interface fa0/1;no shutdown
verification: Interface status becomes connected

symptom: PC cannot reach remote network
evidence_output: Default gateway is configured as 192.168.1.254 instead of 192.168.1.1
fix: Configure the correct default gateway 192.168.1.1
verification: PC can reach the remote network

symptom: PC cannot communicate with local devices
evidence_output: PC uses 255.255.0.0 while the network requires 255.255.255.0
fix: Change subnet mask to 255.255.255.0
verification: PC communicates with local devices

symptom: Intermittent connectivity is observed
evidence_output: Two different MAC addresses are associated with the same IP address
fix: Assign a unique IP address to the conflicting device
verification: Only one device uses the IP address

symptom: PC cannot communicate with the expected subnet
evidence_output: PC has 192.168.20.10 but it should use the 192.168.10.0/24 network
fix: Change the IP address to a valid 192.168.10.0/24 address
verification: PC receives the correct network configuration

symptom: Client receives no valid IP address
evidence_output: Client receives an APIPA address 169.254.x.x and DHCP pool is absent
fix: Create the required DHCP pool
verification: Client receives a valid DHCP address

symptom: New clients cannot obtain IP addresses
evidence_output: DHCP pool shows 0 available addresses
fix: Expand the DHCP address pool or remove unnecessary exclusions
verification: Clients obtain available IP addresses

symptom: Clients receive an incorrect gateway
evidence_output: DHCP configuration provides the wrong default gateway
fix: Configure the correct default-router in the DHCP pool
verification: Clients receive the correct gateway

symptom: Some addresses are unexpectedly unavailable
evidence_output: DHCP excluded range contains addresses that should be available
fix: Correct the DHCP excluded-address configuration
verification: Expected addresses become available

symptom: Website names cannot be resolved
evidence_output: DNS server is configured as 8.8.8.8 instead of the internal DNS server
fix: Configure the correct DNS server
verification: Internal names resolve successfully

symptom: Internal hostname cannot be resolved
evidence_output: DNS returns NXDOMAIN for the internal hostname
fix: Create or correct the missing DNS record
verification: nslookup returns the correct IP address

symptom: Clients cannot resolve any domain names
evidence_output: Configured DNS server is unreachable
fix: Restore DNS server connectivity or configure a reachable DNS server
verification: DNS queries receive responses

symptom: Remote network is unreachable
evidence_output: No route exists to the remote network
fix: Add a static route to the remote network
verification: Remote network appears in routing table

symptom: Traffic is sent to the wrong router
evidence_output: Static route uses an incorrect next hop
fix: Configure the correct next-hop address
verification: Traffic reaches the correct next hop

symptom: Network behind router is unreachable
evidence_output: Router interface connected to the network is administratively down
fix: interface g0/0;no shutdown
verification: Interface status becomes up/up

symptom: Remote network is missing from routing table
evidence_output: Remote network is not included in the routing protocol configuration
fix: Add the missing network to the routing protocol configuration
verification: Remote network appears in the routing table

symptom: Allowed traffic is being blocked
evidence_output: ACL contains a deny statement matching the traffic
fix: Modify the ACL to permit the required traffic
verification: Allowed traffic passes successfully

symptom: Traffic is blocked unexpectedly
evidence_output: ACL is applied to the wrong interface
fix: Remove the ACL from the wrong interface and apply it to the intended interface
verification: Traffic follows the intended ACL policy

symptom: ACL rules do not behave as expected
evidence_output: ACL is applied in the wrong direction
fix: Apply the ACL in the correct inbound or outbound direction
verification: ACL behaves according to the intended policy

symptom: Internal users cannot access external network
evidence_output: NAT inside configuration is missing on the LAN interface
fix: interface g0/0;ip nat inside
verification: Internal clients can access external network

symptom: NAT translations are not created
evidence_output: NAT outside configuration is missing on the WAN interface
fix: interface g0/1;ip nat outside
verification: NAT translations appear

symptom: Internal network traffic is not translated
evidence_output: NAT ACL does not permit the internal network
fix: Add a permit statement for the internal network to the NAT ACL
verification: NAT translations are created for internal clients

symptom: Client cannot find the expected wireless network
evidence_output: Configured SSID does not match the expected SSID
fix: Configure the correct SSID
verification: Client can see and select the correct SSID

symptom: Client cannot authenticate to Wi-Fi
evidence_output: Wireless security key does not match the configured password
fix: Configure the correct wireless password
verification: Client authenticates successfully

symptom: Wireless client receives an address from the wrong network
evidence_output: Wireless client traffic is mapped to the wrong VLAN
fix: Assign the wireless SSID/interface to the correct VLAN
verification: Client receives an address from the correct VLAN

symptom: Wireless clients have no network connectivity
evidence_output: Access point uplink is down
fix: Enable and restore the access point uplink connection
verification: Wireless clients regain connectivity

symptom: Wireless client cannot obtain an IP address
evidence_output: Wireless client receives 169.254.x.x because DHCP is unavailable
fix: Restore DHCP service or correct the wireless DHCP configuration
verification: Wireless client receives a valid IP address
